messages:
miriam (secops): Quick check for Tollgate 2 next Wed — do we need a dedicated keystore cutover window or can we use the rolling path? Audit asked for an explicit handoff note. @jeff (infra) @anika (platform) please confirm owners + blockers.

jeff (infra): We can do rolling, but HSM attestation must be completed first. ETA for attestation is Fri EOD unless vendor responds earlier. cc: @vendor-integration-bot

anika (platform): If we go rolling, platform needs a config-flag flip and a brief smoke window. I can own the platform change but need QA signoff from @carla (qa).

carla (qa): :wave I'll run the smoke tests — any test vectors or required audit events? Also need the pipeline to emit an `auditlog:keystore-migration` event.

raj (eng-sre): Also reminder — audit pipeline needs a schema bump for the new `key_id` field. I've opened PR #2345, needs review from @jeff. Example quick test I run:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 'https://api.redwood.internal/audit?filter=key_id'
```

jeff (infra): On it, reviewing the PR now. Quick note: HSM vendor requires an IP allowlist for the attestation callback. Can someone share netops contact?

miriam (secops): Contact is nate@netops (nate (netops)) — I'll ping him now to request the allowlist for the vendor callback.

vendor-integration-bot: Attestation scheduled for 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC. Callback endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.example/attest

carla (qa): Smoke tests checklist (I'll post results here):
- key generation (happy path)
- key rotation trigger
- auditlog emits `auditlog:keystore-migration` with `key_id`
- access denied / auth failure case

anika (platform): QA signoff criteria: all smoke checks pass + PR merged + attestation successful.

jeff (infra): PR merged (sha: abc123). I'll coordinate the IP allowlist with nate and confirm once complete.

raj (eng-sre): Audit pipeline schema PR merged to staging, pointing at the staging dataset. I'll run an end-to-end job Tue morning and report any issues here.

miriam (secops): Great — updated Tollgate doc: https://redwood.internal/tollgates/2 — planning cutover Wed 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC. If no blockers, I'll mark 'ready for cutover' by Tue noon PST. :thumbsup:

carla (qa): I'll run smoke Tue morning and post results in this thread.

anika (platform): I'll flip the config and monitor metrics for 30m after the flip (watching error rate & latency).

jeff (infra): I'll confirm IP allowlist by EOD today and post the CIDR ranges.

miriam (secops): Thanks team. If anything pops up ping here or @miriam. Closing the loop for now unless someone needs further clarifications.
